title: AI chip maker SambaNova raises $1B at $11B valuation, 5 months after last mega round
slides: SambaNova just raised another billion—why so fast?
It sells custom chips for AI training and inference.
But its last $5B valuation round closed only five months ago.
Clients now can deploy AI without giant cloud bills.
Test SambaNova hardware before committing to your next model.
thread_text:
1. Second billion in five months?

SambaNova closed a $5B round just five months ago. Now another billion. The speed is the story.

2. Custom chips, not cloud bills

Its hardware lets clients train and run AI without renting expensive servers. No giant monthly cloud costs.

3. Try before you commit

Prospective buyers can test SambaNova hardware on their own models before any purchase. No locked-in contracts.

4. Who is paying for this?

The funding comes as enterprises rush to cut infrastructure spend. Private AI deployment is the prize.

5. Test your next model this week

Contact SambaNova for a trial run on your current training workload. See if the chip saves you money.
